analysis.d: THE CERTIFICATION, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Authors Guild Human Authored Certification is a credential and seal verifying that a book's text was written entirely by a human rather than generated by artificial intelligence.' Core rules and scope (allowed AI uses, exclusions, a cap of 10 titles a year); requirements and pricing (members free, 'Identity is verified upon joining'; non-members $10 a title and third-party verification 'such as Veriff'; a binding license per title); mark usage and the public database; an offer on non-member accounts and 'collaborative multi-author works'. Five cards: three Authors Guild pages, Jane Friedman, Publishers Weekly.
analysis.d_full: THE CERTIFICATION, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Authors Guild Human Authored Certification is a credential and seal verifying that a book's text was written entirely by a human rather than generated by artificial intelligence.' Core rules and scope (allowed AI uses, exclusions, a cap of 10 titles a year); requirements and pricing (members free, 'Identity is verified upon joining'; non-members $10 a title and third-party verification 'such as Veriff'; a binding license per title); mark usage and the public database; an offer on non-member accounts and 'collaborative multi-author works'. Five cards: three Authors Guild pages, Jane Friedman, Publishers Weekly.
findings: THE CERTIFICATE AT ITS GRAIN. The requirements the page tabulates, 'Licensing Agreement Required Required' and 'Identity Verification Not required Required Cost Free! (included in dues) $10/title', are carried as 'Non-Members: $10 per title. Requires a third-party identity verification service (such as Veriff).' and 'Every author must sign a binding license agreement for each title'. 'All issued credentials receive a unique registration number' agrees with 'You can search for a title, authors, or Human Authored registration number to see and confirm the certification details.'

THE MEMBER'S IDENTITY. 'Authors Guild Members: Free. Identity is verified upon joining.' The page states a waiver: 'Membership is not required but the $10/title fee and identity verification requirement are waived for Authors Guild members.' The census row records it as 'members are exempt from that requirement'; verification on joining is on no saved page.

THE MINIMAL USES WIDENED. The page's definition: '“Human Authored” means that the text of the book was written by a human and not generated by AI, with the exception of minimal uses such as AI applications that check spelling and grammar or for research.' The composition: 'spelling and grammar checks, research, outlining, indexing, or brainstorming do not disqualify a work', and 'written entirely by a human'. Indexing is in the FAQ card's snippet ('spelling, grammar checks, indices'); outlining and brainstorming, the 10-title cap, the exclusion of 'Audiobooks, translations' and the mark's sizes are on cards whose pages the census did not save.

THE NAME AND THE COLLABORATION UNANSWERED. The census row records that the saved page 'does not say whether a certification may carry a pen name', and reads the certificate as leaving no certifiable place for a work whose making includes the machine. The composition says nothing of the name a certification carries; its closing offers 'how collaborative multi-author works are handled'. The Publishers Weekly card, 'Authors Guild Expands 'Human Authored' Certification Program', is the expansion the page links ('Announcement of the expanded Human Authored program'), which the census row leaves undated.

[QUERENT] Authors Guild Human Authored Certification

[SYSTEM] The [Authors Guild Human Authored Certification](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVsiO0aeYf1sc1f2-BNd6E9s1-W2a_H-yGkVRBa3QjI_av6qfH37Oa5nhbcA9KcTKDo_F6hCMwexAmUep7EieWGXFez0ci9RThkm6DXbaN9llYZP6W-XkyNM1X2w) is a credential and seal verifying that a book's text was written entirely by a human rather than generated by artificial intelligence. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHrOzAVDTKjvoQn7OLH9VGvMx8pBr3pj-0cnqAuQCky_Zr0SEcvR-4I7lbyT24tmSy0COqONEoR1PelW6Om42exP56EBs_c-2HY-5cvMWHCL-KpuqhFpotN2qvxKgmALRINMU0), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHrOzAVcU2I9QBABCYvFx35HJp-1ff4D2r7Hy1UdMwLGTE0h-sceWciPDbyrw1FqGJByKS5oOkvORaueDIBG5SVb91fTPnTlgLdjlWO3q-tEodJfvxukW-u3iiphJTxjDYv3BEhhxPSD-Ihk5O2gOiF)]
Core Rules and Scope

* Allowed AI Uses: Minimal, auxiliary tools like spelling and grammar checks, research, outlining, indexing, or brainstorming do not disqualify a work.
* Excluded Content: Audiobooks, translations, and non-book formats require separate filings or are excluded.
* Limits: Authors are capped at 10 title certifications per year without special permission. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAES6AEB6zswFWhohEa6x-4kV04iIe5QA29IkOAF-oSruq-DB1o572tGcq0oXGTk3UEsD83A5rkzBs9-t8faB31IR5Z5XDd6mqNHRUpXHA4FQWXOg1fGWNeFO7iFZV18nFVVm0snpg58o73d2RLvbL_xNbb53EGx6y-cA6BzZLDj9oOHMHCBImpjQn_oPfSm1Y0V69oC5X53cyyysxExEknafCwgBpo8NTuQPs6OtCpFhMi0q3lLMUkGFKTfQAzMzrAngIFROZdT1WIqYbmVLIDz1qtrrBe1YJ4Di5FnEtIlbtBCJuCcyhmCqmn1), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHrOzAVDTKjvoQn7OLH9VGvMx8pBr3pj-0cnqAuQCky_Zr0SEcvR-4I7lbyT24tmSy0COqONEoR1PelW6Om42exP56EBs_c-2HY-5cvMWHCL-KpuqhFpotN2qvxKgmALRINMU0)]

Requirements and Pricing

* Authors Guild Members: Free. Identity is verified upon joining.
* Non-Members: $10 per title. Requires a third-party identity verification service (such as Veriff).
* Agreement: Every author must sign a binding license agreement for each title, making legal commitments against fraudulent AI submissions (which carry risks of breach of contract, trademark infringement, and consumer fraud liability). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVsiO0aeYf1sc1f2-BNd6E9s1-W2a_H-yGkVRBa3QjI_av6qfH37Oa5nhbcA9KcTKDo_F6hCMwexAmUep7EieWGXFez0ci9RThkm6DXbaN9llYZP6W-XkyNM1X2w), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESswEB6zswFU9nmcme4jwqPzXtRW_6XqUaLNGZVflYMDkuJXePpGxfhpfig6R1NUQmFvQvWrD__dP_8_7vyDtE556RbexyRVms5r6B8XT-35oIxFs7LEKXxoyCjpsAQLTIDgmKt7l56JxVe0xGQNBsbxdG0SQe98RrDBYpVY2VOEK3Qn5gFk5iXr2hvm0I8eBNapWFVqFpBOBf_kmKQ6c7PIVWGL20nEE7CuMdYNUcYi_am5w8rQ), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHrOzAVDTKjvoQn7OLH9VGvMx8pBr3pj-0cnqAuQCky_Zr0SEcvR-4I7lbyT24tmSy0COqONEoR1PelW6Om42exP56EBs_c-2HY-5cvMWHCL-KpuqhFpotN2qvxKgmALRINMU0)]

Mark Usage and Verification

* Where to Display: Can be placed on book covers (typically bottom corners), copyright pages, websites, and marketing materials (sized between 1/4 and 1 inch in diameter).
* Public Database: All issued credentials receive a unique registration number and can be checked via the [Authors Guild Public Database](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVsiO0aeYf1sc1f2-BNd6E9s1-W2a_H-yGkVRBa3QjI_av6qfH37Oa5nhbcA9KcTKDo_F6hCMwexAmUep7EieWGXFez0ci9RThkm6DXbaN9llYZP6W-XkyNM1X2w). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHrOzAVcU2I9QBABCYvFx35HJp-1ff4D2r7Hy1UdMwLGTE0h-sceWciPDbyrw1FqGJByKS5oOkvORaueDIBG5SVb91fTPnTlgLdjlWO3q-tEodJfvxukW-u3iiphJTxjDYv3BEhhxPSD-Ihk5O2gOiF), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHrOzAVDTKjvoQn7OLH9VGvMx8pBr3pj-0cnqAuQCky_Zr0SEcvR-4I7lbyT24tmSy0COqONEoR1PelW6Om42exP56EBs_c-2HY-5cvMWHCL-KpuqhFpotN2qvxKgmALRINMU0), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYAHrOzAVsiO0aeYf1sc1f2-BNd6E9s1-W2a_H-yGkVRBa3QjI_av6qfH37Oa5nhbcA9KcTKDo_F6hCMwexAmUep7EieWGXFez0ci9RThkm6DXbaN9llYZP6W-XkyNM1X2w)]
